# Dominant Programming Language Projections for 2035

## Summary

Python remains the most widely adopted programming language globally. [S2] JavaScript maintains a dominant position in web development with 66% developer usage. [S2] TypeScript ranks #1 on GitHub by repository count. [S2] The programming language market size is projected to reach $311.4 billion by 2030. [S4]

## Current Market Landscape

JavaScript dominates web development at 66% developer usage (Stack Overflow 2025). [S2]

## Limitations

- The evidence does not provide specific projections for which programming language will dominate in 2035.
- No data on the projected growth rates of individual programming languages beyond the market size as a whole.
